snippet.title: Cosmic Race: Galactic Showdown - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ] [4K]
snippet.description:
Cosmic Race: Galactic Showdown is an arcade racing game that involves vehicular combat in extra-terrestrial locations, featuring both single-player and PvP multiplayer modes. Players defeat their opponents in the biggest racing tournament of the galaxy to be the Galactic Champion! The game celebrates the fun of retro racing games through stylized visuals and synthwave music.

Official Steampage:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2475170/Cosmic_Race_Galactic_Showdown/

This trailer is part of the Indie-Credible - Indie Game Showcase 2026:
